description_en: Changes the IPv6 address of a dual-stack Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance from public to private
description_zh: 将双栈NLB实例的Pv6地址从公网变更为私网
kebab_example: aliyun nlb disable-load-balancer-ipv6-internet --load-balancer-id nlb-83ckzc8d4xlp8o0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisableLoadBalancerIpv6Internet

parameters.help_en: The Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without changing the network type of the IPv6 instance. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the check, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the check, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. After the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会变更Pv6类型实例的网络类型。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
